items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: You were talking to Run the Tio, eh?

ctx.x: In the Superior I think. I don't think he was a regular member.
It wasn't lower. You were talking to Run the Tio, eh? Oh, yeah. Yeah, Run the Tio.
We talked to his brother. He has a brother, Louie Tio I believe is his name. dear
